blocks.text: Kidney transplant aisi surgery hai jis mein kisi shakhs ka kaam na karne wala gurda donor ke sehatmand gurde se badla jata hai. Yeh aakhri darje (end-stage) ki kidney failure walon ko pesh kiya jata hai, aur behtareen nataij ke liye wusool kunanda (recipient) aur donor dono ki ehtiyat se jaanch, mutabiqat (matching) aur nigrani chahiye.

blocks.caption: Mumkina donors
rows: recipient ka jeeni (genetic) rishtedar, jaise walid ya walida, bhai behan ya aulad; behtareen donor ho sakta hai
jeeni rishtedar nahi, jaise shareek-e-hayat, dost ya saathi karkun; kam aam, magar blood group aur tissue type milen to kamyab ho sakta hai
woh log jo maut ke baad aaza dene ke liye hospitals mein register hote hain; un ke gurde blood group, tissue type aur immune mutabiqat se milaye jate hain

blocks.title: Kya aap jante hain?
blocks.text: Gurde ka atiya aakhri darje ki gurde ki bimari wale ke liye zindagi bachane wala tohfa ho sakta hai. Kitab batati hai ke gurda dene se donor ki sehat ko lambe arse ka koi khaas khatra nahi aur tehqeeqat ke mutabiq donors ki aam sehat aur umar aam taur par mutasir nahi hoti.

blocks.title: Maloomat ke liye
blocks.text: Pakistan ka pehla kidney transplant centre 1985 mein Sindh Institute of Urology and Transplantation (SIUT), Karachi mein qaim hua, jise kitab duniya ke sab se bare aur kamyab transplant centres mein se aik kehti hai. Pakistan Kidney and Liver Institute and Research Center (PKLI&RC), Lahore ka tertiary-care hospital, 2017 mein gurde aur jigar ki bimariyon ke ilaj, transplant aur tehqeeq ke liye qaim hua.

items: Rejection (radd hona): recipient ka immune system naye gurde ko ajnabi samajh kar us par hamla kar sakta hai, chahe mareez immunosuppressant dawayein le raha ho.
Infection: jin mareezon ka immune system dabaya gaya ho unhein transplant ke baad infection ka zyada khatra hota hai.
Immunosuppressants ke side effects, jo rejection rokne ke liye di jati hain: high blood pressure, wazan barhna aur infections aur cancers ka zyada khatra.

blocks.prompt: Kidney transplant ke mareezon ko immunosuppressant dawayein kyun di jati hain, aur is ki qeemat kya hai?
blocks.explanation: Ta ke immune system diye gaye gurde ko ajnabi samajh kar radd na kare. Qeemat kamzor difa hai: zyada infections aur cancers, aur high blood pressure aur wazan barhne jaise side effects.

items: Transplant nakara gurde ko badalta hai (end-stage failure); donors: rishtedar, ghair rishtedar, faut shuda, blood group aur tissue type se milaye jate hain.
Masail: rejection, infection, immunosuppressants ke side effects. SIUT Karachi 1985; PKLI&RC Lahore 2017.
